_note: Text drawn inside each figure by scripts/make_figures.py: titles, axis labels, legends and notes, in English. Captions are not here. A missing key stops the builder rather than falling back to a default.

vi-tri-tren-mat.title: Scalarisation tracks the front maximum; the parameter-free selectors stop inside
vi-tri-tren-mat.xlabel: size bound K (at most K vertices and K edges)
vi-tri-tren-mat.ylabel:
position on the non-dominated front
(0 = floor, 1 = maximum)
vi-tri-tren-mat.cell_note: each faint dot is one support threshold

hoi-tiec-theo-co-dua.title: The estimation term runs out; the transfer floor does not
hoi-tiec-theo-co-dua.ylabel_worst: estimation term in the worst cell (%)
hoi-tiec-theo-co-dua.balanced: {n} cells with data at every size
hoi-tiec-theo-co-dua.caption_note: The two lines have DIFFERENT DENOMINATORS. The all-cells line stops at size 10 because {dropped} cells have no seeds beyond it; continuing it with the fewer-cells line would draw a step that never happened.
hoi-tiec-theo-co-dua.worst_note: The difference is taken WITHIN EACH CELL and only then maximised. Maximising the regret and the floor separately subtracts across TWO DIFFERENT CELLS.

dia-hinh-bi-ep-doi.title: Forcing the landscape to change moves no method
